Oatmeal Fudge
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 19, 2009 - 11:36pm

Ingredients




1 stk butter
2 cups Sugar
1/2 cup Milk
Bring to boil and stir while boiling for 3 min. exact
1/2 cup Cocoa
2 cups Oatmeal
1/2 cup Coconut
1/2 cup Pecans
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1 pch Of salt

Preparation

1 Oatmeal Fudge 2 Mix quickly and spoon out onto wax paper. 3 Make sure you get all of your ingredients together first because you must mix the second half of the stuff in as soon as you take the boiling mixture off the stove. It really is good and very sweet. I usually make just a half recipe. 4 Happy cooking!
